note: Manual audit of the 21,350-observation production plan against the merged code. PASS needs a named test or an inspected location; FAIL is a verified engineering gap or mismatch; BLOCKED needs a researcher decision, authorization, hardware or a measurement; NOT_RUN was not executed. Nothing here approves a gate. E7a update (2026-10-23): the supervisor and the K18 diagnostic findings are resolved for bounded fixtures; production launch stays unimplemented. E7a review update: independent multi-lens review of the supervisor, K18 diagnostics, training proposal and documentation; the material findings are fixed with regression tests (P30 section 9). Items touched by E7a cite line numbers at the E7a head; untouched items cite 755b474. Main moved to 5d3f1a3 when PR #21 (the first, pre-review E7a state) was merged; this round is its follow-up. The audit base for items not touched by E7a stays 755b474. Main is now 0e8c467 (PR #22 merged the review hardening); a post-merge audit and its fixes are in the hotfix that follows. E7b reconciliation: verified main ed65eb5 contains PR22/23; the raw PR23 job log confirms 1632 passed and seven skips. Separate bounded training/calibration/freeze/evaluation and a bounded LOKO matrix close engineering gaps without authorizing production or choosing R1-R10. Untouched audit items retain historical citations.

items.title: Existing CLIs cover all three production stages
items.message: geosim.b2_dataset (--roles, --limit-groups, --groups-per-shard, --cancellation, --config), geosim.b2_test_dataset and geosim.b2_matched_dataset (--known) exist with the flags the E5 plan names; no unrestricted launcher is supplied and none was run.
items.verified_by: inspection: argparse definitions read at the cited lines

items.title: The plan's four groups per shard is not the generators' default (eight)
items.message: All three generators default GROUPS_PER_SHARD to 8, which would double the interruption loss (64/40/24 observations). The value is part of the request, so it cannot drift silently; `audit --production` rejects any root whose request is not the frozen production request.

items.title: Cross-stage source, config and known-root binding is enforced before use
items.message: The test-only and matched generators bind the known root's fingerprints and calibration but not its generator source hashes, so a stage built from different code still verifies on its own. The preflight audit with --known flags source, numpy/scipy, config and canceller drift between stages.

items.title: An interrupted known root resumes without rewriting verified shards
items.message: A kill between shards leaves a RESUMABLE root; the generator keeps committed shards byte-identical and the final arrays equal an uninterrupted run. Loss per interruption is bounded by one shard.

items.title: A kill between the data-file renames and the descriptor commit fails closed
items.message: Data files without a committed descriptor make the generator refuse the root (unverified partial shard). This is safe but not automatic: the audit reports NEEDS_QUARANTINE and recovery is a manual move of the orphan files to a quarantine directory (never deletion), after which the resume is bit-equal. An unattended supervisor must implement that runbook (see audit.stage_supervisor_missing).

items.title: Modified shards, metadata and calibration are detected before use
items.message: Checksum depth reads every committed shard and fails on a single flipped byte; the cheap structure depth cannot see byte flips and is labelled as such. Deep depth additionally runs the generator's own semantic validator on a bounded sample. Manifest-level and root-level tampering is checked with the generators' own `_header` and exercised on all three stages.

items.title: An immutable source/config/environment lock can be created and verified
items.message: The lock hashes every src/**/*.py and the bundled curves, the frozen configs, the gates file and the generator provenance, and records the git commit, tree cleanliness, Python/NumPy/SciPy versions and BLAS thread settings. Any drift is named; edited lock files fail their own fingerprint.

items.title: A manifest's recorded git commit is not evidence of an unmodified source tree
items.message: The generators record `git rev-parse HEAD` without a dirty flag ("unknown" when git fails), and the request hashes only src/geosim/*.py and its data, not src/geoml or the configs. The lock covers the whole source tree and configs and can require a clean tree.

items.title: Role/group isolation is checked on every committed shard
items.message: Group ids are checked against the frozen reserved ranges and for repetition across shards and roles; a request whose test role holds training groups, or a descriptor with a foreign group, is INVALID.

items.title: The streaming trainer refuses wrong-role and test-only sources
items.message: fit_streaming requires known-kind sources of the train and val-select roles and disjoint scenario groups (E1 evidence, unchanged by E6).

items.title: Streaming reads verify shards and fail closed on missing or damaged ones
items.message: Verification of 384-observation-per-role fixtures ran at about 430 observations/s (E1 note); this is a bounded-fixture measurement, not a production-size one (see audit.streaming_unmeasured_at_scale).

items.title: Raw IQ is transient; artifacts hold spec, mask, residual and index arrays only
items.message: The generator drops the IQ after the canceller and the reader rejects unexpected array keys. Consequence: the fifth channel exists only because it was computed at generation time, so a new receiver version needs regeneration of every residual-bearing stage.

items.title: A path/length/SHA-256 transfer manifest can be created and verified after a copy
items.message: Implements E5 plan step 5: missing, extra, resized and modified files are named; a restored backup must still be re-audited shard by shard before training.

items.title: No frozen production training configuration exists; a candidate specification awaits researcher decisions
items.message: E7a prepared a reviewable candidate (docs/plan/B2_E7_TRAINING_SPEC_PROPOSAL.md, b2_e7_training_proposal.json: 29 parameter records, ten numbered decisions R1-R10, measured/analytic footprint). It is explicitly not frozen and not approved; width, epochs, batch, optimizer/scheduler, seeds, window, interruption and test-coupling policy need the researcher before a production config can be committed, any value other than the P6 / TrainConfig default (and any data-driven epoch sizing) is a change to P18 section 5 ('P6 settings, no search') that needs a P18 section 10 entry, and R10 asks to confirm the acceptance 0.95 / Pfa 0.05 / Mahalanobis 0.1 constants that P20 and the pilot config state but P18 does not. configs/b2_feat.json remains the 3-epoch pilot. E8 adds an unapproved, non-loadable candidate (docs/plan/b2_e8_candidate_production_config.json) and an approval-ready matrix (docs/plan/B2_E8_DECISION_APPROVAL.md).

items.title: The train-only center/CE ratio diagnostic is recorded by both trainers and in the result JSON
items.message: geoml.train.fit and geoml.b2_stream.fit_streaming return an additive train_diagnostics block (B2-train-diagnostics/1: per-epoch mean CE, weighted/unweighted center term, weighted/unweighted plan BCE, center/CE ratio with counts and an unavailable reason, embedding rms, provenance; observation_only, affects_training=false, split=train). b2_experiment and b2_loko now write it next to history, together with best_epoch and best_val_macro_f1 so a reader of the summary can pick the evaluated checkpoint's epoch out of the block. Bit-identity with origin/main 755b474 (goldens, verbatim original loops, gradients, RNG) is tested on CPU fp32 (torch 2.14.1, 1/2/4 threads; an independent review compared 268 configurations without a mismatch); GPU parity is not tested here and belongs to the bounded DR-05 probe. Editing train.py, b2_stream.py, b2_experiment.py and b2_loko.py changes their hashes in checkpoint provenance (P28 section 6); earlier checkpoints are not relabelled. K18 itself stays PENDING_RESEARCHER; this is a diagnostic only.

items.title: A fail-closed staged supervisor exists (bounded fixtures only; the production launch is not implemented)
items.message: scripts/b2_production_supervisor.py (P30) runs known, test-only and matched in order as supervised children: dry run by default, immutable lock re-verified before every stage and attempt, relocatable run identity (plan, ceilings, timing, heartbeat and launcher), hash-chained journal anchored by journal.head with a tail check on every append, wait4 exit codes/CPU, monotonic elapsed time, polled child RSS (ru_maxrss kept as an upper bound), heartbeats and an estimated charge for a lost supervisor, wall/CPU/RSS/failed-attempt/interruption/disk ceilings (fixtures and production plans cannot raise them), first-shard timing gate, SIGINT/SIGTERM handling, the process group emptied after every attempt, a child that dies with the supervisor, an unreadable host probe failing closed, orphan quarantine (never deletes), and completion only for the exact planned inventory produced under the plan by a clean supervised attempt. Every spawned command must carry --limit-groups 1..2; production execution is always refused. Exercised by 166 tests (the post-merge audits added 39) (stand-in children under the real generator CLIs, a mutation pass in which all but two equivalent mutants are killed) and by a capped real-physics run (two groups per stage, interrupted once, supervisor SIGKILLed once, resumed to completion).

items.title: A deterministic bounded LOKO planner, dispatcher and verified multi-seed aggregator exist
items.message: P31 plans seven non-clean holdouts x three seeds x explicit views. An immutable selection permits at most two capped CPU cells per output root; native artifacts, COMPLETE status, source/data/config bindings, score rows and point-metric denominators are verified. Missing full inventories fail closed; explicit partial summaries have null full-matrix metrics. Seed spread and shared-scenario intervals stay separate; no scores are pooled across seeds or held-out tasks. No production/full21/full63 sweep is enabled or run.

items.title: Interrupted training cannot resume; restart-versus-snapshot policy is undecided
items.message: A checkpoint stores model weights (best epoch) only, not optimizer, scheduler, RNG or the data cursor. Either a separately reviewed snapshot is built, or an interrupted seed/view restarts from epoch 0 with the parent checkpoint hash recorded. That is a policy decision before GPU use.

items.title: Streaming memory and throughput are unmeasured at production size
items.message: E1 fixtures hold at most 384 observations per role; the production train role holds 12,000. The window-memory arithmetic is verified (12.06 MiB raw and 20.0 MiB preprocessed per 32-observation shard) but peak memory and per-epoch I/O at scale need the authorized data or a separately approved synthetic-layout fixture.

items.title: Generation wall time is an extrapolation from a 60-observation matched profile
items.message: 23.0-30.2 h reproduces arithmetically from 3.8-5.0 s/observation, but the known stage's group mix differs from the matched profile and nothing was timed beyond 64 observations. A start-up gate that compares the first committed shards with the band (stop if outside) belongs to the authorized run, not to this preflight. E7a's capped real-physics run (this sandbox, two groups per stage, clean tree) cost 4.67 s/observation for the known stage (64 observations, three attempts including the restarts and the estimated charge of one lost attempt), 5.25 for test-only (10) and 4.76 for matched (6) as whole-attempt wall per observation including start-up; the first-shard gate figures (3.1-4.5 s/observation) subtract a fixed 6 s allowance from 3-8 observation shards and are not per-observation costs, so they neither confirm nor refute the 3.8-5.0 band for any stage. Nothing was timed at production size.

items.title: Production host, GPU and backup target are not designated
items.message: The E5 numbers (36 h wall, 42 core-h, 25 GiB working disk, a separate 9 GB backup, 8/16 GiB host RAM, 8-12 GiB VRAM) are proposals. No host, GPU or backup location has been named or authorized, so host probes can only prove an unrelated machine unsuitable.

items.title: Supervisor verified end to end with real physics on a two-group-per-stage fixture
items.message: Real generators (obs-cancel/1), 80 observations in total, clean tree at commit 92f78be (the hotfix code; the PR #22 code was verified the same way at dd5d965): the dry run created nothing (exit 4); SIGINT after the first known shard gave exit 6 with a resumable root, verify exit 5 and a refused completion (exit 3); the supervisor was then SIGKILLed mid-attempt (its child died with it), the next start recorded supervisor_lost with an estimated charge, and the third start finished all stages; verify exit 0 and completion.json (scope fixture, production_complete=false, benchmark_complete=false, supervisor/preflight SHA-256 recorded). Child peak RSS 566-582 MiB in the measured attempts (polled VmHWM; the lost attempt's last heartbeat 507 MiB); five attempts, wall 375 s, CPU 443 s, the lost attempt's share estimated. The raw journal (112 records) is committed and verifies with Journal.load.

items.title: The unbounded production launch is not implemented
items.message: By design (PRODUCTION_LAUNCH_ENABLED is False; every child needs --limit-groups 1..2). Enabling it is a later, separately authorized and reviewed milestone that needs: the four approved gates, a production-size first-shard timing validation on the designated host, and a review of the unbounded command builder.

items.title: The compute budget assumes width 8 but the trainer defaults to width 16
items.message: The 200-1000 samples/s band and the 6 GPU-h reservation were written for the width-8 pilot network; TrainConfig and P6 default to width 16 (about 3.3x the multiply-accumulates; K18 D/2 ratio 128 instead of 64). The width is researcher decision R2; the budget must be recomputed for the chosen width. E8 recomputed the screening arithmetic per width (scripts/b2_e8_budget.py, docs/results/b2_e8_resource_budget.json): nine width-16 fits are about 10.0-21.9 h of GPU compute plus un-overlapped loader, versus the withdrawn 6 GPU-h; it stays BLOCKED until the bounded probe measures the target host.

items.title: Independent bounded training, calibration and frozen-inventory evaluation modes exist
items.message: Train-only opens train/val-select only, Mahalanobis uses train only, and a separate calibration opens known val-calib. Proposed-full admission validates nine native view/seed cells and frozen thresholds before held-out opening; evaluation fits nothing and preserves input bytes. Fixture admission is explicit and cannot masquerade as full-protocol admission. New execution remains CPU <=2groups/role, <=2epochs,width<=8,batch<=32; the legacy coupled pilot is capped at12groups/role. R8 and all production decisions remain unapproved; no production-width16/30epoch executor is authorized.

items.title: The training data loader is synchronous
items.message: No DataLoader, prefetch or workers exist. At the E1 rates the train-read and preprocessing path alone is roughly 39 minutes per 30-epoch fit (about 5.9 h for nine fits); the estimate omits the val-select read and preprocessing and the K17b re-preprocessing, which bring it to about 47 minutes per fit and 7.0 h for nine (roughly 1.9x the whole 6 GPU-h reservation); unverified on the target host. The authorized GPU probe must measure end to end.

items.title: GitHub Actions on the E8 pull-request head
items.message: Not run before publication. The exact head/run/job and raw results are recorded in the draft PR after publication; historical merged-head CI does not certify the E8 head.

items.title: No executor exists for the recipe the proposal describes (width 16, 30 epochs, full roles, GPU, isolated phases)
items.message: The isolated train-only/calibrate/freeze/evaluate modes are CPU-only and capped at 2 groups/role, 2 epochs, width 8, batch 32 (src/geoml/b2_execution.py:39 CAPS, :92 _cpu); --device cuda is refused for every non-legacy mode (src/geoml/b2_experiment.py:819); the legacy coupled runner stops at 12 groups/role (:54) and couples test evaluation. Approving R1-R10 therefore cannot start a fit: lifting the caps and adding GPU support is a src/geoml edit that changes every checkpoint provenance and the production lock, so it must be a separately reviewed milestone before the lock, the data run and any fit (also where the TF32 pin of R6 would be implemented).

items.title: The bounded GPU probe is specified but not implemented
items.message: docs/plan/b2_e8_gpu_probe_spec.json fixes configurations, caps, measurements and refusals; no executor exists, none was run, and no GPU was touched. It needs the researcher's host/GPU/caps message, the R2/R5/R6 decisions and an independently reviewed executor.

items.title: The independently reviewed release gate is a process step, not a machine-checked record
items.message: Production launch is impossible in this build (PRODUCTION_LAUNCH_ENABLED False, every child needs --limit-groups 1..2) and stays refused with every gate approved (tests). The supervisor's authorization reads only the gates JSON approvals (K18, K17d, OBS-CANCEL-2, full_generation); there is no record of an independent review of the release. The enabling milestone must add and verify such a record (see docs/plan/B2_E8_GO_NO_GO.md section 4) and the approval records remain self-asserted JSON whose control is review at merge.

items.title: A read-only host/environment inventory compares a machine with the proposed requirements
items.message: scripts/b2_host_inventory.py reads CPU, RAM, cgroup limits, disk space (stat only), an optional nvidia-smi driver query and library metadata; it creates no file except an exclusively created --out, imports neither torch nor CUDA and never reports a designated host or authorization. A missing GPU is BLOCKED; a measured shortfall is FAIL. The sandbox fails both roles (19.7 GiB free, same-device backup, no GPU).

items.title: The production lock does not record the GPU numerics environment
items.message: scripts/b2_production_preflight.py environment() (lines 323-331) records Python, platform, NumPy, SciPy, torch and xgboost versions and the thread variables only. It does not record CUDA/cuDNN versions, GPU model, driver, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES or the TF32/deterministic flags, and no source file sets those flags (git grep allow_tf32 in src and scripts is empty), so on an Ampere or newer GPU torch 2.14.1 runs cuDNN convolutions in TF32 by default although the recipe says fp32. What to pin is decision R6; recording it in the lock belongs to the executor milestone, before the lock is created.

items.title: TrainConfig code defaults silently disable the P20 centre loss and the K17b shift
items.message: geoml.train.TrainConfig defaults are center_loss_weight 0.0 and plan_shift_fraction 0.0 (plan_loss_weight 1.0, width 16, epochs 30, batch 32); the pre-registered 0.005 centre weight and the 15 % / 0.5 MHz K17b shift exist only in configs/b2_feat.json, a 3-epoch width-8 pilot config. A production run built from 'the defaults' would therefore train without K18's centre term and without the frozen augmentation. The frozen production configuration (after the R-decisions) must set both explicitly, and the executor milestone should refuse a production profile that leaves them at 0.
